pages.title: Overview
pages.summary: An introduction to Aegis, a vendor-agnostic secrets broker and PAM gateway that allows teams to manage their own API keys and secrets securely.

pages.title: Architecture
pages.summary: Details the architecture of Aegis, including its components and how they interact to manage secrets across various vaults.

pages.title: Configuration
pages.summary: Covers the configuration options available for Aegis, including environment variables and vendor-specific settings.

pages.title: Usage
pages.summary: Explains how to use Aegis, including API endpoints for fetching secrets and managing team self-service functionalities.

pages.title: Deployment
pages.summary: Guidelines for deploying Aegis in various environments, including Docker, Helm, and Terraform configurations.

pages.title: Audit and Change Logging
pages.summary: Describes the audit logging features of Aegis, detailing how actions are logged and can be queried.

pages.title: Key Management
pages.summary: Information on how Aegis manages API keys, including generation, rotation, and suspension.

pages.title: Security Model
pages.summary: Overview of the security model implemented in Aegis, including authentication, authorization, and protection mechanisms.
